note: Ambulance attendants and the ER (hospital flow).

lines.text: Make room! Make room! Who's hurt?
Third shooting tonight. Third. Okay, on the stretcher.
Stay with me. Look at me. What's your name?
Ten minutes to the hospital. You'll make it. You're too stubborn not to.
You're out. Hospital bill's in the envelope. Don't come back. You'll come back.
Heatstroke on the third floor. The old men are dropping like flies in this.
Generator's on! Generator's on! Keep bagging!
